bunkasai.executiveSummary: At the inaugural Bunkasai 2026 Japanese Cultural Festival in Pune, our combined batches Fushimi and Akagi proudly won the #1 Best Project award. Our interactive exhibition celebrated four iconic Japanese traditions: Tanabata, Daruma, Omikuji, and Juunishi. A defining personal milestone was speaking entirely in Japanese with native Japanese guests to explain the lore of Tanabata, bringing language learning to life.
bunkasai.fullSummary: We are absolutely over the moon!! 🎉🎊 Bunkasai 2026 — a Japanese Cultural Festival held at Yashwantrao Chavan Kaladalan, Pune — and our team just brought home #1 Best Project on the very FIRST edition of this amazing event!! 🙌🔥 Our batches — Fushimi and Akagi — came together and built something truly special. Our booth celebrated 4 incredible Japanese cultural themes: 🎋 Tanabata — hanging our wishes to the stars, 🎎 Daruma — setting goals and never giving up, 🎴 Omikuji — fortune slips, destiny, and good luck, 🐉 Juunishi — the 12 zodiac signs and fortune telling. Every single person in both batches gave it everything — the creativity, the preparation, the energy, the passion. Watching visitors light up as they learned about each tradition made it all SO worth it! 😍 One of the most unforgettable highlights for me personally? I got to speak with a native Japanese speaker entirely in Japanese, explaining the history and traditions of Tanabata to him. The look on his face when I spoke — priceless!! 😄🗣️🇯🇵 And it wasn't just me — so many of our team members got to have real conversations with Japanese people throughout the event. Putting our learning into practice, live, in the moment — THAT is what this journey is all about!! 💪🔥 And honestly — the whole festival was INCREDIBLE. Kimono try-ons 👘, omikuji fortune booths, chopstick challenges 🥢, a Sapporo Snow Festival corner ❄️, 3D shrine models ⛩️… two days of pure Japanese culture magic! This win is for EVERY member of Fushimi and Akagi. Every late night, every decoration, every practice session — it all paid off. We couldn't be prouder of this team! 🌸🔥 Massive thank you to AtoJ Hirameki Japanese Language Classes, our amazing teachers, organizers, and volunteers! You made this dream possible 💙 チームワーク最高!! Best team ever!! 🚀🎌
